requirements.quote: The fully assemble Device must be able to perform recognition of fingerprints
Power – The Device must switch ON and OFF
requirements.text: Device must switch ON and OFF.

requirements.quote: Buttons – All buttons are functional when pressed
requirements.text: All buttons must function when pressed.

requirements.quote: Camera – When button 4 or Gun triggered button is pressed, the camera must open, and the illumination LED must switch ON.
requirements.text: Camera and LED must activate when specific buttons are pressed.

requirements.quote: Assemble all the Device sub-modules (requirement 4.1, requirement 4.2 and requirement 4.4) inside the enclosure (requirement 4.3) to have a fully assembled Fingerprint Recognition Device.
requirements.text: Assemble all sub-modules into the enclosure for a complete device.

requirements.quote: Fully assembled Device must be connected to a network port via an ethernet cable.
requirements.text: Connect the device to a network port using an ethernet cable.

requirements.quote: GPS - Device GPS coordinates (GPS fix) must display on the screen or stored locally on the database.
requirements.text: Device GPS coordinates must display or be stored locally.
